paragraphs: Emovis sells tolling and mobility technology and operating services to road operators and transport agencies around the world. Its remit covers the tolling chain from roadside systems and revenue collection through enforcement and customer service.

The products bring together vehicle identification and classification, data analytics and back-office software to process large volumes of tolling transactions. An operational back office takes the data captured at the roadside and makes it accurate, enriched and ready for billing. A manual image review service pairs automated processing with human checking to validate vehicle passage records. The gantry-based Identify system reads passing vehicles using video tolling or pay by plate, so no physical barrier is needed.

Buyers are public entities and private companies that need a partner to run tolling operations. The company reports more than 850 experts worldwide and over four decades of experience. It is backed by Abertis Group, which it describes as managing 5000+ miles of motorways with over 17,000 employees. Emovis says it has helped clients in the mobility and transportation industry in more than 10 countries.

quote.text: Emovis is a worldwide provider of tolling and mobility solutions.
